configurations.name: waf-https-proxy
runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),https=require('https'),tls={rejectUnauthorized:false}; http.createServer((q,r)=>{const t=https.request({hostname:'127.0.0.1',port:8443,path:q.url,method:q.method,headers:q.headers,rejectUnauthorized:false},u=>{r.writeHead(u.statusCode,u.headers); u.pipe(r)}); q.pipe(t); t.on('error',e=>{r.statusCode=502; r.end(String(e))})}).listen(7777,()=>console.log('proxy on 7777'))
